reviews.summary: Reviewer Michal Hocko expressed familiarity issues with the MGLRU code and stated that, despite not being deeply familiar, the patch appears to be correct based on a quick look.
reviews.raw_body:
I am not deeply familiar with MGLRU to give my ack but from a quick look
this looks right.

2026-08-13.patch_summary: This patch removes the lru_gen_soft_reclaim() function from the Linux kernel's memory cgroup (memcg) implementation. The function was only called by the soft limit rbtree, which is no longer needed after its removal. As a result, the MEMCG_LRU_HEAD operation is also removed and the memcg LRU comment is updated to reflect this change. This patch is part of a larger series of changes to the memcg implementation.
